about: The diagnostic codes that mean a solve input is missing: the person must enter a value the solve needs, and the finding's affected_refs name the entity that lacks it (and, where the solve states it, the field). One source for every reader: the engine (open_pipe_stress_product_physics::solve_input_missing_codes) and the desktop (apps/desktop/src/features/diagnostics/solveInputMissingCodes.ts) take the list from this file, and a reader decides by code, never by message text. Hand-made. core/product_physics/tests/model_checks_runtime.rs holds it against fixtures/diagnostics/exact_route_codes.json: every member is a code the solve crates construct, classified input_error, and every input_error code whose name ends in _MISSING is a member. A code whose name does not say MISSING joins only by an edit here that names it. A member's severity is the finding's own: a warning-level member is an input whose absence the solve discloses without refusing.
